faqs.q: Do I have to pay anything to start?
faqs.a: No. The requirement call and the shortlist cost nothing. Our fee is agreed with you in writing before you commit to a property.

faqs.q: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.a: Mainly west and central Pune: Kothrud, Karvenagar, Warje, Erandwane, Prabhat Road and Bavdhan. Tell us your area and we'll say honestly whether we can help.

faqs.q: Do you only deal in resale flats?
faqs.a: Resale is our core, but we also help with new projects through our developer relationships, and with bungalows, row houses and plots.

faqs.q: Will you check the property documents?
faqs.a: Yes. We review the title chain, society documents and approvals before you pay a token, and bring in a lawyer for anything that needs a legal opinion.
